title: Not Sick
description: When Dad serves soup for lunch, Kid-3 objects that soup is what she eats when she’s sick—and she’s not sick.
alt: In a cozy kitchen, Dad sets a bowl of soup on the table for lunch. Kid-3 points to herself with an indignant expression and says, “Soup?! That’s what I eat when I’m sick. I’m NOT sick!” Dad looks on with a small, amused smile.
